data.one_liner: Typing animation widget with rich text support and controller for reset, freeze, unfreeze
data.what_it_does: Provides a TypeThis widget that animates text like a typewriter. It supports custom speed, text style, alignment and rich text styling via regex matchers. A controller lets you reset, pause, or resume the animation.
use_when: You need a typewriter-style text animation in a Flutter app
You want to pause or restart the animation programmatically
You need to apply different styles to parts of the animated text
avoid_when: You only need a simple static text display
You require complex animation sequences beyond typing
You are building a non-Flutter project
strengths: Rich text styling via regex matchers
Controller for fine-grained control (reset, freeze, unfreeze)
weaknesses: No advanced animation features like physics or Lottie
No support for custom character rendering beyond TextStyle
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec, import package, use widget

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a broader set of animations but not specifically typing animation

alternatives.name: lottie
alternatives.why_pick_it: For complex animated sequences but not typing effect
